title: Fixed Opposed Hollow Dee Chambers and Return Yoke Display
description: One wholly newly authored static scientific-apparatus cutaway exhibit. A complete grounded plinth carries one continuous thick return-yoke form, its lower arm, full rear upright and retained shortened upper arm. A broad lower pole-disc and round chamber floor carry two independent hollow horizontal D-shaped bodies on four short fixed support posts. Each has a closed curved back, thick floor and one genuine open straight mouth facing the other across a continuous central slot. After the first actual image looked like two solid half-discs, this first real visual repair explicitly removes the entire left D roof, retaining its true thick floor, curved wall, finite rim and open straight mouth; the right D keeps its complete roof. The newly exposed interior is an intentional cutaway, not a transparent trick or a hollow claim based only on a hidden sample. A thick rear curved chamber-wall sector remains, while the front wall and entire lid are deliberately omitted. Only the rear segment of the upper pole-disc remains, its flat cut chord explicitly exposing the foreground bodies. A continuous blank rectangular winding-case appearance surrounds the rear yoke, and two closed side-stem appearances meet the D-shell backs. Unlike the U-yoke hand-generator there is no rotating axial drum, winding loops, crank or split-ring brushes; unlike the opposed annular-bowl exhibit there is no shared axis, toroidal cavity, curved vane field or small central guide ring. All visible geometry is new and authored together as one complete exhibit, not old magnetic and pump parts arranged into a scene. One model zero scenes, four opaque constant untextured PBR appearances, metre game coordinates/native Z up and complete horizontal bounds centred over the whole plinth sole. Cyclotron-inspired schematic artistic exterior only, not an accurate scientific instrument or an engineering design. No particle source or beam, electricity, radiofrequency, accelerating field, vacuum, resonance, magnetic field, radiation, calibration, experiment, image, precision, functional electrode/feedthrough, manufacture, operation or safety capability is made or verified. Omitted casing and upper pole regions are deliberate visible cutaway scope, not missing promised opaque walls. Rigging animation interaction not made.
